passage.text: Jen Taylor is a travel blogger from Canada.
passage.reading: ˈdʒɛn ˈteɪlər ɪz ə ˈtrævəl ˌblɑːɡər frəm ˈkænədə.

passage.text: She is thirty-four years old, and she has visited fifty countries on five continents!
passage.reading: ʃiː ɪz ˌθɜːrti ˈfɔːr ˈjɪrz ˈoʊld, ənd ʃiː hæz ˈvɪzɪtɪd ˈfɪfti ˈkʌntriz ɑːn ˈfaɪv ˈkɑːntɪnənts!

passage.text: Every week, thousands of people read about her adventures.
passage.reading: ˈɛvri ˈwiːk, ˈθaʊzəndz əv ˈpiːpəl ˈriːd əˈbaʊt hɜːr ədˈvɛntʃərz.

passage.text: She has climbed a volcano in Indonesia and walked in the jungle in Malaysia.
passage.reading: ʃiː hæz ˈklaɪmd ə vɑːlˈkeɪnoʊ ɪn ˌɪndəˈniːʒə ənd ˈwɔːkt ɪn ðə ˈdʒʌŋɡəl ɪn məˈleɪʒə.

passage.text: But she doesn't always stay in hotels.
passage.reading: bʌt ʃiː ˈdʌzənt ˈɔːlweɪz ˈsteɪ ɪn hoʊˈtɛlz.

passage.text: She often stays in a homestay with a local family.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈɔːfən ˈsteɪz ɪn ə ˈhoʊmsteɪ wɪð ə ˈloʊkəl ˈfæməli.

passage.text: "In a homestay, you eat with the family and learn their language," she says.
passage.reading: ɪn ə ˈhoʊmsteɪ, juː ˈiːt wɪð ðə ˈfæməli ənd ˈlɜːrn ðɛr ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ, ʃiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: Last year, Jen traveled around the world in eight months.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈjɪr, ˈdʒɛn ˈtrævəld əˈraʊnd ðə ˈwɜːrld ɪn ˈeɪt ˈmʌnθs.

passage.text: She has been to Thailand three times.
passage.reading: ʃiː hæz bɪn tə ˈtaɪlænd ˈθriː ˈtaɪmz.

passage.text: Her favorite places here are Chiang Mai and Krabi.
passage.reading: hɜːr ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈpleɪsɪz ˈhɪr ər ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ənd ˈkrɑːbi.

passage.text: "Thai street food is the best in the world!" she says.
passage.reading: ˈtaɪ ˈstriːt ˌfuːd ɪz ðə ˈbɛst ɪn ðə ˈwɜːrld! ʃiː ˈsɛz.
